'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Joe Pinto DS Spice Mine Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Pinto]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Spice Mine Operations|VB7-D-spicemineoperations-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
